projects.name: edgar-mcp
projects.tagline: SEC EDGAR tools with bounded context, caching, and global pacing.
projects.problem: Filings are large, issuer identities are ambiguous, and naive concurrent clients can violate the SEC request ceiling.
projects.mechanism: Identity resolution, filing history, bounded text windows, XBRL discovery, per-host cache validation, and a global request pacer.
projects.attack: Cold and warm reads, burst traffic, identity collisions, overflow history, and malformed iXBRL.
projects.proof: 32 offline tests; peak request windows stay at the SEC 10 requests-per-second ceiling.
projects.limitation: Public EDGAR data only; it is not an investment recommendation or a complete accounting model.
projects.command: git clone https://github.com/asp53826/edgar-mcp && cd edgar-mcp && make test

projects.name: aad-greeks
projects.tagline: Reverse-mode automatic differentiation over Monte Carlo paths.
projects.problem: Bumping every pricing input scales linearly and finite differences collapse near discontinuous payoffs.
projects.mechanism: A tape-based reverse-mode AD engine with pricers written once and differentiated instead of hand-derived.
projects.attack: Analytic Black-Scholes formulas, central differences across bump sizes, and discontinuous-payoff failure cases.
projects.proof: 19 tests; all Greeks cost 1.7-2.4x the price across a 50x change in input count.
projects.limitation: Pathwise derivatives return a wrong zero delta for an unsmoothed digital payoff; the live lab exposes it.
projects.command: git clone https://github.com/asp53826/aad-greeks && cd aad-greeks && make test

projects.name: lob-market-making
projects.tagline: Price-time matching and market making under toxic flow.
projects.problem: Raw PnL can make a strategy look strong while inventory exposure and adverse selection carry the risk.
projects.mechanism: Limit order book, post-only orders, informed flow, three quoting strategies, and exact PnL decomposition.
projects.attack: Paired 12-seed strategy comparison with spread, inventory, and toxicity held explicit.
projects.proof: 36 tests; naive quoting wins raw PnL and loses every risk-adjusted metric.
projects.limitation: Synthetic order flow without exchange latency, queue-position uncertainty, or real fees.
projects.command: git clone https://github.com/asp53826/lob-market-making && cd lob-market-making && make test
